ZAMEEN ALPHA (PRIVATE) LIMITED
NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 JUNE 2023
1

COMPANY AND ITS OPERATIONS

1.1

Corporate and General Information
Zameen Alpha (Private) Limited ("the Company") was incorporated on 13 February 2019 as a Private Limited
Company under the Companies Act, 2017. The Company's principal activity is to engage in the business of
development of all types of real estate including commercial markets and multi-storey buildings, shopping centres
etc. The registered office of the Company is situated at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road Gulberg III, Lahore.
The Company is a subsidiary of Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited ("the Parent Company"), a Company
incorporated in Pakistan. The ultimate parent of the company is Dubizzle Group Holdings Limited (formerly known
as EMPG Holdings Limited), a Company incorporated in United Arab Emirates (UAE).

1.2

The Company holds 50% share in Mall 35 (the Firm), a partnership firm which was established on 26 June 2019
in Pakistan. The firm was registered with the Registrar of Firms under section 58 (I) of the Partnership Act, 1932
on 09 June 1998. Its primary place of business and registered office is located at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam
Road Gulberg III, Lahore. The principal activity of the Firm is to undertake, manage, market and sell the project,
Mall 35 on the land located in Rawalpindi. The Company's owners / directors are also Partners in the Firm. As at
30 June 2023, the project is under development phase.
The Company has reported profit of Rs. 23,321,685 (2022: Rs. 2,888,114) and its accumulated losses as at the
reporting date amounts to Rs. 16,348,797 (2022: Rs. 39,670,482) resulting in a negative equity of Rs. 16,346,797
(2022: Rs. 39,668,482) as at that date. The Parent Company has committed to provide financial support to the
Company, enabling the Company to continue its operations as going concern and fulfil all of its financial
obligation. Based on which the financial statements of the Company are prepared on going concern basis.

2

BASIS OF PREPARATION

2.1

Statement of Compliance
These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the accounting and reporting standards as
applicable in Pakistan. The accounting and reporting standards applicable in Pakistan comprise of:
- International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS Standards) issued by the International Accounting Standards
Board (IASB) as notified under the Companies Act, 2017; and
- Provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017.
Where provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017 differ from the IFRS standards, the
provisions of and directives of the Companies Act, 2017 have been followed.

2.2

Basis of measurement
These financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention unless otherwise stated.

2.3

Functional and presentation currency
These financial statements are presented in Pak Rupees, which is the Company’s functional currency. All figures
have been rounded off to the nearest Rupee, unless otherwise stated.

2.4

Standards, interpretations and amendments to published accounting standards
The following are new and amended standards and interpretations effective for annual period beginning on July
01, 2022, as listed below:
